description: This file defines API endpoints related to authentication, including login, registration, user profile retrieval and update, and token refreshing, using FastAPI. It manages user sessions and interactions with the user repository, handles password hashing, and constructs JWT tokens.

methods.name: login_user( login_data: UserLogin = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles user login, verifies credentials, and returns a JWT token along with user info.

methods.name: register_user( user_data: "UserCreate" = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles new user registration, ensures uniqueness, hashes password, and returns a JWT token with user info.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves the profile of the current trusted user.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile( user_update: UserUpdate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates the profile details of the current trusted user.

methods.name: refresh_access_token( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Provides a new access token for the current user.
